name: file_to_base64
description: Encode ANY file (image, audio, video, document, anything) inside the working folder to base64 WITHOUT polluting the conversation. The base64 text is huge, so the tool NEVER returns it: it saves the base64 into a .b64.txt file in the working folder and returns one short sentence plus the metadata (paths, sizes, mime, sha256, data-url prefix, short preview). Reference the saved path in later tool calls (or read it in pieces with read_file) — never paste the base64 text into the chat.

path.description: Working-folder-relative file path to encode, e.g. images/photo.png. Max 20MB.

output_name.description: Base name for the saved .txt in the same folder (default: <source>.b64.txt). Overwrites when it already exists.
